newsitem.title: UK: Railtrack sets 760 mln stg station outlays.
newsitem.headline: Railtrack sets 760 mln stg station outlays.

text.p: Britain's Railtrack Group Plc said on Thursday that it was aiming to complete a 760 million stg update programme for its stations and depots by 2001.
Railtrack announced this as part of a 15 billion stg spending package it has chalked out for the next 10 years.
"Our objective is still to deliver a radical imrpovement in the quality of stations by March 2001," the group said in a statement.
It said it was implementing organisational changes to ensure completion of the update programme which included clearing the backlog of mantenance and renewals at 2,360 stations and 87 depots.
